title: Revolutionary relics, Metropolitan Fair, N.Y (NYPL b11708071-G91F217 002F)
blurb: * Hand-colored photoprints. Includes two hand-colored views. Includes views by Anthony, Bierstadt Brothers, G.G. Rockwood and other photographers and publishers. Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Title devised by cataloger. Views of the Metropolitan Fair, showing dispalys of art, arms and trophies, "fire department," "New Jersey Department," seamanship room, revolutionary relics, machinery, burglar alarms, and a view of the Tiffany sword valued at $45,000.00 given to Grant; views of the American Insitute Exhibition Industrial Fair showing building and interiors with machinery.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.2% vertical error and 0.01° of rotation. Depth measured deep (3.25% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
collection_name: Robert N. Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views
